questions.stem: 请朗读下面的短文。
questions.passage: Paper was invented in China about two thousand years ago. It was made from trees, old cloth and fishing nets. Before paper was invented, people wrote on bamboo or silk. questions.passage:
Paper is one of the most useful inventions in the world. It was invented in China about two thousand years ago by a man named Cai Lun.

Before paper was invented, people wrote on bamboo or silk. Bamboo was heavy and silk was expensive. Cai Lun made paper from trees, old cloth and fishing nets. His paper was light and cheap. Soon it was used all over China. Later, the way of making paper was brought to other countries.

Today paper is used everywhere. We write on it, read books made of it, and even make clothes from special paper!

This was a great invention. Books could be printed faster and cheaper. More people could read books and learn new things.

The compass is another great invention of China. It was invented more than two thousand years ago.

At first, it was not used for travelling. It was used to tell directions when people built houses. Later, it was used by sailors on ships. With a compass, sailors could find their way on the sea even at night.

The compass was brought to Europe about eight hundred years ago. It helped people travel around the world. Today, compasses are still used, but many people use phones to find directions.
